title: SEC reviewing implications of delayed prediction market ETFs, Atkins says
summary: SEC Chair Paul Atkins said he instructed the agency's staff to seek public input on prediction market ETFs.

title: Hyperliquid ETFs attract record $25.5 million in net inflows as institutions pile in
summary: U.S. spot HYPE ETFs saw $25.5 million in net inflows on Wednesday, marking their largest positive flows since launch.

title: Fed seeks input on expanding master account access following Trump’s executive order
summary: Trump signed an order on Tuesday requesting the Fed to review and update regulations to integrate digital assets into traditional systems.

title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX holds $1.45 billion worth of bitcoin as firm looks to go public
summary: A stockpile of over 18,000 would make Elon Musk's SpaceX the seventh-largest Bitcoin holder, ahead of Coinbase.

title: CryptoQuant says bitcoin mirrors 2022 bear market pattern as sentiment turns ‘extremely bearish’
summary: Bitcoin’s recent rally hit resistance at the 200-day MA near $82,400, a pattern CryptoQuant said is similar to the March 2022 bear market.

summary: Nakamoto’s reverse split will shrink outstanding shares to about 17.4 million from roughly 696 million, following a 99.5% price drop.

summary: Securitize said it now services roughly 650 active funds and processed $1.9 billion in transaction volume during the quarter.

title: Hyperliquid ETFs draw $22.3 million in early inflows, analysts point to ‘good sign of organic interest’
summary: Hyperliquid ETFs have outpaced bitcoin and ether funds in adjusted inflows during parts of their early trading.
